families.standard_mathematical: Unicode mathematical alphabets with direct alphabetic mapping.
families.decorative_substitution: Custom lookalike tables mixing symbols and scripts.
families.hybrid_generator: Random or semi-random per-character style mixes.
families.wrapper: Text surrounded or interleaved with visible delimiters.
families.combining_mark: Base text modified with overlay, underline, strike, box, or storm marks.
families.enclosed_alphanumeric: Circled, boxed, keycap, or squared symbols.
families.asemic_symbolic: Glyph clusters that may map at word or token level rather than letter level.
families.symbol_cipher: Nonalphabetic symbol-set mapping such as Wingdings-like modes.
